items.title: How Meta's Muse is driving a magic moment for the stock market

items.title: The AI panic, tech concentration, and Nvidia windfalls
items.summary: Gabelli Funds' John Belton and Wells Fargo Advisors' James Taylor break down the viral "doomer" warnings rippling through the AI industry, and why slowing down development might actually prevent a massive tech bubble.

items.title: Should investors play AI bottlenecks over social media stocks?
items.summary: Should investors bet more on the AI infrastructure bottlenecks than on other tech trends, such as social media? Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick, and Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management CEO Ross Gerber.

items.title: Chip Stocks Drop After Six-Day Climb For SOX Index
items.summary: The Philadelphia semiconductor index, known as SOX, slid Wednesday as chip stocks took a breather after a six-day climb.

items.title: ARM Vs. AMD: Who Is Going to Win the Agentic AI CPU Revival War?
items.summary: AMD and Arm both just posted earnings that position them as the backbone of agentic AI computing, but their paths into the same data center could not be more different. One is booking record revenue while the other bets its future on a chip that has yet to ship.

items.title: MindWalk (HYFT) Is Pivoting to Recurring AI Revenue. Can ReefIQ Offset Widening Losses?
items.summary: Commercial launch of ReefIQ data platform marks a strategic pivot for MindWalk Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ:HYFT). In its first quarter FY27 report, the company also highlighted its transition toward platform-based recurring revenues. items.title: AMD Just Cracked $1 Trillion and One Strategist Says $750 Is Next
items.summary: A top strategist just structured a trade on AMD that stops paying him the moment his own price target is hit, and that contradiction reveals something important about where this stock actually goes from here.

items.title: What Changed In AMD's Story?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has stopped leading with the problem that opened its call a year ago. That problem was keeping one of its accelerators out of China. The latest call was fiscal Q2 2026. This time, management did not lead with the subject at all. So what was AMD leading with back then.
